topics.name: Ownership vs Authority Rules
topics.purpose: Define semantic ownership and runtime authorization as orthogonal rule dimensions.

semantics.auth_rule: AccessCore grants scoped runtime resource/operation authority.
semantics.noninherit_rule: Owner does not automatically receive user/session rights.
semantics.reverse_rule: Authorized user does not become semantic owner.
semantics.audit_rule: Any implicit mapping is a conformance finding.

invariants.rule: Every conformance rule has exact identity, scope, inputs, predicate/evaluation semantics, severity/blocking behavior and finding representation.
Conformance rules never rely on newest-wins, mtime, filename similarity, path proximity, UI layout, fuzzy identity matching or undocumented implementation defaults.
